scenes.title: Sunlit Morning Clinical Bedroom: Awake Eyes, Flat Muscle-Brake Trace -> Calm Toe-Flex Release (Zero Horror)
scenes.era: 2021 Clinical Sleep Suite & Peaceful Sunlit Morning Oak Bedroom

layout.description: Clean, bright, peaceful morning bedroom flooded with warm golden sunrise light through sheer cream linen curtains (zero dark shadows, zero scary figures): a 45-year-old adult in light sage-blue cotton pajamas lies supine on crisp white sheets beside an oak nightstand holding a clear glass of water and a sleek unmarked dual-trace sleep monitor, attended by a calm sleep clinician near the doorway console.

positions.who: Awake morning sleeper (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult with smooth earless noseless hairless oval head and wide-open calm 2D charcoal-black ink eyes in sage-blue cotton pajamas)
positions.where: lying flat on their back in a sunlit oak bed with arms resting peacefully atop a crisp white linen duvet
positions.facing: looking calmly toward the sunlit window and clear bedside water glass

positions.who: Sleep neurologist (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult in crisp white lab coat over navy shirt)
positions.where: standing quietly beside the unmarked dual-channel sleep waveform display
positions.facing: observing the upper awake wave and lower flat motor-brake line transitioning cleanly

props.name: unmarked dual-channel bedside polysomnography screen
props.period_detail: text-free clinical display showing a brisk cyan-blue upper brainwave and a flat amber-gold lower muscle-tone line (93.8% atonia)
props.physical_behavior: State-A: upper cortical trace ripples briskly while lower muscle line stays flat -> State-B: sleeper gently flexes toes/fingers and the lower muscle trace springs smoothly into active waves

props.name: crisp white linen bedsheet and clear glass of morning water on oak nightstand
props.period_detail: peaceful everyday morning bedroom setting with zero horror or dark elements
props.physical_behavior: State-A: sleeper's hands rest completely still on the white sheet -> State-B: fingertips curl gently, sleeper sits upright in warm sunlight, and lifts the clear water glass smoothly

actions.verb_sequence: lies completely still in bright morning sunlight with wide-awake ink eyes -> flexes fingers gently against the white sheet as the monitor's lower line wakes up -> sits upright smoothly and lifts the bedside water glass

reactions.reaction: relaxes 2D ink eyebrows with a calm relieved smile once the protective dream brake clicks off
nods reassuringly pointing to the clean synchronized handoff on the unmarked waveform screen

scenes.wardrobe: 45-year-old sleeper in tailored sage-blue cotton pajama top and trousers; clinician in navy collar and white coat.
scenes.lighting: Bright, warm, peaceful golden-hour morning sunlight streaming across white linen — strictly high-key and reassuring.
scenes.recognition_hook: Your eyes are wide open in bright morning sunlight while your body's protective dream brake takes ten extra seconds to hand back the keys!

key_visual.description: a peaceful sunlit morning bedroom where an awake adult in sage pajamas flexes fingers on crisp white sheets beside an unmarked dual-wave sleep monitor and lifts a clear water glass

scenes.title: 2012 University of Toronto Dual-Brake Bench: GABA + Glycine Triple-Switch Lock
scenes.era: 2012, University of Toronto Sleep Neurobiology Laboratory (Brooks & Peever)

layout.description: Bright high-key Toronto laboratory bench featuring a physical three-latch brass-and-ceramic safety clutch demonstration model paired with a translucent 3D brainstem-to-motor model.

positions.who: Toronto sleep researcher (2.5D matte cream-white vinyl figure in white lab coat)
positions.where: standing behind the sunlit laboratory table operating the three-latch mechanical clutch model
positions.facing: facing camera across the clean workbench

props.name: unmarked three-latch mechanical safety brake model
props.period_detail: visualizes Brooks & Peever's (2012) GABAA + GABAB + glycine cooperative lock with zero text labels
props.physical_behavior: State-A: flipping one latch alone leaves the bar locked -> State-B: flipping all three latches together slides the bar smoothly open

actions.verb_sequence: lifts one single brass latch while the bar stays locked -> lifts all three latches in unison to slide the safety bar open

reactions.reaction: attentive Eureka expression confirming why single-drug tests missed the dual lock

scenes.wardrobe: Crisp white laboratory coat over charcoal knit shirt.
scenes.recognition_hook: Evolution built a triple-latch safety lock so vivid dreams never throw you out of bed — all three latches must click off to move.

scenes.title: Sunlit Morning Park Walkway: Resetting the Circadian Wake-REM Clock (Outdoor)
scenes.era: Modern sunlit morning neighborhood park path

layout.description: Open-world sunlit morning park path lined with green maples where the rested 45-year-old adult in a navy cardigan walks briskly holding a ceramic travel mug in crisp morning sunlight.

positions.who: Rested adult walker (2.5D matte cream-white vinyl character in navy cardigan and chinos)
positions.where: walking briskly along the sunlit park path

props.name: unmarked cream ceramic travel mug in morning sunlight
props.period_detail: anchors consistent morning circadian light exposure recommended in sleep hygiene reviews
props.physical_behavior: State-A: walker steps onto sunlit park gravel -> State-B: lifts warm mug with effortless fluid arm motion

actions.verb_sequence: strides smoothly onto the sunlit park path -> raises travel mug comfortably in full morning light

scenes.wardrobe: Navy knit cardigan over white tee and khaki chinos.
scenes.recognition_hook: Regular morning sunlight and side-sleeping keep your wake switch and dream brake synchronized.
